_description: Taiwan party/candidate -> left/right/other mapping used by pycensus.countries.taiwan.elections. Taiwan's real cleavage is pan-green (DPP, Taiwan-identity, socially liberal, centre-left on welfare) vs pan-blue (KMT, PFP, NP: pan-China/ROC-identity, conservative, pro-business). Mapping used: pan-green -> left, pan-blue -> right, TPP and independents -> other. Edit 'bloc' values to change; unlisted parties default to 'other'. Candidate overrides (keyed by tag) win over party.

民主進步黨.justification: DPP (pan-green): centre-left, progressive social policy (marriage equality, labour, welfare), Taiwan-identity.

中國國民黨.justification: KMT (pan-blue): conservative, pro-business, favours closer cross-strait engagement.

台灣民眾黨.justification: TPP: centrist populist, formed 2019 by Ko Wen-je; cross-cutting, allied with KMT in 2024 talks and rival in 2022/2024. Treated as 'other' (neither bloc).

時代力量.justification: NPP: progressive, left-liberal, pan-green-aligned; ex-Sunflower movement.

台灣基進.justification: TSP: pro-independence, progressive-left on social issues (could be argued 'other' as a nationalist party).

台灣團結聯盟.justification: TSU: pro-independence but socially conservative; pan-green by identity, right-leaning on values.

無黨籍及未經政黨推薦.justification: Independents / not party-endorsed: no ideological position by default (see candidate overrides).

無黨團結聯盟.justification: Non-Partisan Solidarity Union: independents' alliance, mixed.

黃珊珊.justification: Independent (ex-Taipei deputy mayor under Ko Wen-je, TPP-backed in 2022, centrist/pan-blue-leaning electorate).
